text: {"lessons":["Selling winners feels satisfying, but I should avoid trimming automatically just because a position is above my cost; consider its prospects and portfolio role.","Judging each stock separately against my purchase price can lead me to overvalue gains and avoid confronting losses; focus on forward-looking risk and return.","Even after several profitable sales, my account value fell over the later periods, so I should monitor total portfolio performance and maintain diversification rather than equating realized gains with success."]}
